chapter: Opening talk: pianists and Buddy Petit
title: Piano players around New Orleans and Buddy Christian
summary: Williams names pianists he knew or knew of, including Steve Lewis, Tony Jackson, Udell Wilson, Arthur Campbell and Buddy Christian.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: Who were some of the other piano players around town?
Well, Steve Lewis and Tony Jackson. You knew him? No, I didn't know him. I knew of him. I didn't know him.
Did you know this guy Alfred Wilson?
No, I didn't know him. I knew of him. He was a piano player here. I just thought you'd know him because of the names or something, you know. I imagine you've heard of him. No, I didn't know him.
Alfred Carroll? No, I know Alibrad Alexander.

Oh, I was a man. You know Udell Wilson. Oh, Udell, yes, indeed. Who wouldn't know Udell? Yes, indeed. Yeah, Udell. And this other piano player, I'm trying to think of his name, he went to Chicago, never come back. New York, at least.
Do you remember Frank Ahamia? Frank Ahamia, no, I don't remember that.
It's all my time. What's Campbell's name?

Arthur Campbell. Arthur Campbell. Arthur Campbell. I heard of him. Steve Lewis used to talk about him all the time. Yeah. Monnie, do you remember? Oh, Monnie Jones, yeah. Monnie, yeah. Cripple fellow. Yeah, I know Monnie. That's Buddy Christian.
Buddy Christian, I know him. Clarence Williams. Yeah. I know all them old timers. Who did they work with, Buddy Christian? Buddy Christian played down at Pete Lowndes, too.
He was at Pete Lowndes at one time, you know.
